title: Role Management SuperAdmin Boundary Consistency

database.reason: No persistence model changes are introduced.

migration.reason: No permission or schema changes are introduced.

permissions.reason: Kyrox Core protects these platform actions with require_super_admin rather than assignable permission codes.

backend.reason: Existing Kyrox Core require_super_admin authorization remains unchanged and authoritative.

audit.reason: Existing Kyrox Core audit behavior remains unchanged.

route_guard.reason: The existing SuperAdmin-only tabs remain unchanged; this hardens the action callbacks themselves.

notes: Role-template update/derive, template sync preview/execute, and permission lifecycle preview/execute now fail closed unless the loaded user-management context identifies the actor as SuperAdmin, matching Kyrox Core require_super_admin guards.
